plan.venue_summary: Mohawk's calendar mixes art-rock and indie (Geordie Greep, Hovvdy, Kishi Bashi) with punk, noise and industrial nights (Linda Lindas, Show Me the Body, Stabbing Westward). Its downtown Austin crowd buys tickets for guitar-forward, left-of-center acts.

recommendations.why: Very strong taste match with fans of Hovvdy, The Linda Lindas and Weatherday. Still an emerging act with room to grow. No recent Austin-area shows or Mohawk date found, so the room is untapped.
recommendations.offer_email:
Hi Dehd team,

I book Mohawk in Austin (indoor/outdoor, 100-500 cap). Our crowd already turns out for Hovvdy, The Linda Lindas and Weatherday, and Dehd's garage-pop sound fits that audience well. We haven't seen you in Austin recently and think a Mohawk show would sell well.

We'd love to offer a headline night on your next Texas run, with Sun June opening. We can share a guarantee/door-split offer and hold dates that fit your routing. What does your fall/spring availability look like?

Thanks,
[Your name], Talent Buyer, Mohawk

recommendations.why: Rising act with a very strong taste match to Mohawk's Hovvdy and Weatherday crowd. No Austin-area shows or Mohawk date found in the last year, so the demand is untapped.
recommendations.offer_email:
Hi Palehound team,

I'm the talent buyer at Mohawk in Austin. Fans of Hovvdy, Weatherday and The Linda Lindas fill our room, and Palehound's raw, melodic indie rock is a natural fit for that crowd. We haven't found a recent Austin date for you, so we'd like to change that.

We'd love to host a headline show on your next Texas run, with Why Bonnie's dreamy set opening. Happy to send a guarantee/split offer and work around your routing. Do you have any windows in mind?

Best,
[Your name], Talent Buyer, Mohawk

recommendations.routing_note: Open date Sun 15 Nov between Austin (14 Nov) and Oklahoma City (16 Nov).
recommendations.why: Very strong taste match with Linda Lindas and Show Me the Body fans, and a real open date on their routing. Caveat: they play Austin the night before, and they're a bigger name.
